bio: I'm a Business and Computer Science student at NYU Stern (Finance + Data Science concentrations), graduating May 2027. I'm drawn to the products people spend their free time in — music, video, games — and to the strategy and data that make them grow.

I've built expansion and product strategies as a consulting summer associate at Strategy&, turned consumer insights into new products and a gamified ambassador program at Xing Fu Tang, and structured music-industry data for AI at Methix. Next up: restructuring at Paul, Weiss in January 2027.
Off the clock, I lead dance covers that have reached millions of views, play ten instruments, run large community events, and am always looking for the next great café.
